sentences.text: The petitioners have annexed a copy of the decree and the joint memo filed by accused No.1 and the complainant in M.C. No.157/2024.
The joint memo indicates that accused No.1 and the complainant have amicably resolved the dispute between them.

In terms of the settlement, their marriage has been mutually dissolved, the custody of the child has been entrusted to the complainant with visitation rights granted to the father-accused No.1, and a sum of Rs.5,00,000/-
has been paid to the complainant as permanent alimony.
The complainant has agreed to withdraw all allegations against accused Nos.1 to 4 and has no objection to the quashing of the impugned proceedings.

4. Although the alleged offences are cognizable and not compoundable, in view of the fact that the parties have amicably resolved the dispute among themselves, it would be a futile exercise to subject the petitioners-accused Nos.1 to 4 to trial, as the probability of conviction is remote and bleak in light of the settlement.
Under these circumstances, the continuation of the impugned proceedings would amount to an abuse of the process of law.

Sd/-
(HEMANT CHANDANGOUDAR) JUDGE YN CT:
